scope: storm/flood/fire/outage-related emergency food-distribution cancellation or suspension
abrupt pantry/food-bank closure or major access reduction
official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
coverage_notes.result: No new qualifying signal was identified in the bounded prior-hour window.
exclusions: Kaua'i hurricane-recovery notice published before the search window; emergency food distributions were proceeding as scheduled.
El Pasoans Fighting Hunger closure coverage concerned a disruption that began several days earlier and was published before the search window.
Older grocery-access closures and generic SNAP/WIC information were excluded as outside the window or non-qualifying.
